text: Please can someone call me back I'm really scared. My granddaughter is 14 months and her lips have gone a bluey grey colour and her skin looks pale and kind of mottled patchy. She's awake and alert, sitting up watching her cartoons and babbling like normal, and she's been drinking her milk fine and ate her tea. But her colour is just not right at all and I don't know what to do. Her mum's on nights so it's just me.
